commemoration.title: Martyr Paramon and 370 Martyrs in Bithynia

_note: Two translations of one hymn. The base row is the St Sergius Menaion; St John of Damascus (Tyler) sings the OCA engraved-music text printed in its choir packet. Same shape as archangels-lic-v2 (memory project_register_knob_is_service_wide): register is not the whole difference, so ?pronoun=yy cannot reach this wording.

_provenance.family_note: Identical to the stichera row it stands in for.

value.text: Having witnessed * a great multitude slaughtered * for the King and God of all, O Paramon, * thou didst burn with divine zeal and cry aloud: * “I am ever a true servant of Christ! * Understand, ye all-iniquitous tyrants, * for, summoned, lo! I have now come * to be slain like an innocent lamb! * Wherefore, be ye not mistaken. * I am defenselessly become * an acceptable sacrifice * to Him Who was slain in the flesh ** for my sake, of His own will.”

value.text:
Witnessing a great multitude slaughtered for the King and God of all,
you burned with divine zeal, O Paramon, crying out:
I am ever a true servant of Christ!
Understand, evil tyrants,
for behold, I was summoned and now I come
to be slain like an innocent lamb!
Therefore, do not be deceived:
I am forced to become an acceptable sacrifice to Him//
Who for my sake was freely slain in the flesh!
